data.name: Vicious Claws
data.description: A catfolk with this talent uses d8s to roll sneak attack damage instead of d6s, but only when she uses her claws to make the sneak attack. A catfolk rogue must have the cat's claws racial trait before taking this talent. [Sneak Attack with Claws %1d8]|SneakAttackDice
